name: Data Masker
description: Detect and mask phone numbers, ID cards, bank cards, emails and more in text.

examples.label: Mask an ID card keeping the tail

hints.text: Masking runs on the server: the text never leaves the backend and only the masked result and counts come back.
hints.output: Samples use placeholders such as 138****8000 and never echo real matched values.

faq.a: The name rule matches two to four Chinese characters, so short sentences may be caught; try it on a small sample first.
It recognises common formats and may miss unusual ones, so keep validating on the business side.
